role: Principal AI & Analytics Engineer — Reporting Platform
responsibilities: Design the reporting architecture, including data ingestion, transformation, analytical data models, metrics, APIs, and the user-facing reporting experience.
Build a self-service report builder that lets authorized users select fields and metrics, apply filters, group and sort results, create visualizations, and export reports.
Deliver a catalog of approximately 60–70 standard reports by defining reusable datasets, metrics, templates, and report configurations.
Translate VMS concepts—including requisitions, submissions, placements, assignments, timesheets, spend, suppliers, rates, and program performance—into consistent, documented reporting definitions.
Establish strong tenant isolation and role-based access so customers see only the data they are entitled to access.
Optimize report performance and data freshness for large customer datasets.
Build automated tests and reconciliation checks that compare report results with source transactions and existing reports.
Evaluate where existing analytics components can accelerate delivery and where a native SimplifyVMS experience is needed.
Use Cursor and other AI coding tools to accelerate development while personally reviewing architecture, generated code, tests, security, and results.
Demonstrate working software frequently, incorporate customer and stakeholder feedback, and own the platform through launch.

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: You should be comfortable moving quickly without compromising data accuracy, tenant security, or maintainability.
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Strong speed language ("hyper speed mode", "Time is of essence", 60-day targets) sits alongside equally strong accuracy language (reconciliation checks, "not by generating 70 report screens that cannot be trusted").
evidence.domain_risk: turn complex VMS data into trusted, fast, intuitive analytics for customers
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Customer-facing workforce and spend reporting in B2B SaaS affects business decisions without regulatory framing, so it is moderate.
evidence.data_team_maturity: own the design and delivery of our next-generation reporting and analytics product that will replace our current reporting/analytics platform
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: The reporting platform is being rebuilt from the start by this hire, so the analytics function is early.
evidence.jd_authorship: Translate VMS concepts—including requisitions, submissions, placements, assignments, timesheets, spend, suppliers, rates, and program performance—into consistent, documented reporting definitions.
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Bullets and a week-by-week plan describe the work concretely (60–70 standard reports, tenant isolation, reconciliation).
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Build a self-service report builder that lets authorized users select fields and metrics
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The audience is the customer-facing reporting product.
evidence.autonomy_level: take ownership of technical decisions, and write production code yourself
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role designs the architecture and owns the platform through launch.
evidence.ai_role: Use Cursor and other AI coding tools to accelerate development while personally reviewing architecture, generated code, tests, security, and results.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: The candidate is expected to use AI coding tools as the main way of building, while reviewing their output.
evidence.testing_framing: Build automated tests and reconciliation checks that compare report results with source transactions and existing reports.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Automated tests and reconciliation checks are responsibilities the candidate builds.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Success will be measured by accurate, usable reports and a durable foundation for future analytics—not by generating 70 report screens that cannot be trusted.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Accuracy and tenant security matter, but within a delivery-first, speed-driven framing, so it is moderate.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: will replace our current reporting/analytics platform
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: A new reporting platform is built to replace the existing one.
evidence.loss_aversion: not by generating 70 report screens that cannot be trusted — accuracy is a guardrail on speed.
